I answered Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate dispatch**.

That comes from Priyanka's posts in that channel on 3 Sep 2025. At 14:06 she wrote that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her note closing the incident at 18:43 says Southgate cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find a street address or site code for Southgate in anything Tobias can see. There's no Tansley account folder in the shared files. So I suggested he ask Priyanka if he needs those details for the call.
